name: mcp__ppt_master__convert_source
description: Convert a pinned PDF with the official ppt-master converter in a fresh session-private directory. Originals stay read-only; no slides are authored.

name: mcp__ppt_master__pin_source
description: Pin a model-selected listed upload to its exact current version. Never choose the paper for the model.

name: mcp__ppt_master__read_converted_source
description: Read the complete official Markdown and asset paths after rechecking source permission and every converted file. Does not certify visual or scientific accuracy.

name: mcp__ppt_master__read_skill_entry
description: Read the official skill entry and guarded routing together; list this Session's approved sources. No slide authoring.

name: mcp__ppt_master__read_source_page
description: Read one page of the pinned PDF, default first page for title/abstract identification. No visual or scientific certification.
